purpose: Separate shelf freshness from checkout readiness. A product may be fresh enough to display when price, stock and destination shipping are freshly verified, while still requiring a new quote at checkout.
truth_precedence: For CJ stock and destination shipping, hunt-cj-quote is canonical over inventory fields embedded in product detail.
Fresh Shelf requires the latest controlled product scan for the destination to be VERIFIED.
Price, stock and shipping evidence must resolve to the exact variant selected by the controlled scan.
Product detail remains canonical for product/variant identity and retail-price/profit-gate inputs, but embedded inventory is not final CJ stock truth.
A stale catalog stock_quantity never overrides a fresh variant quote.
recheck_before_checkout is shelf-eligible but never checkout-ready by itself.
A single CJ product lookup 404 is PRODUCT_FAILED / recheck-required evidence, not proof that the product is permanently removed.
fresh_shelf_requirements: market_eligibility_status is recheck_before_checkout, eligible or allowed
latest controlled product observation for destination has scan_id and refresh_state=VERIFIED
fresh price observation for the controlled exact variant with retail_verified=true and profit_gate_status=PASS
fresh stock observation for the controlled exact variant from canonical quote with stock_verified=true and stock_available=true
fresh shipping observation for the controlled exact variant and destination with shipping_verified=true and numeric shipping amount
all required evidence is within freshness window
checkout_live_requirements: market_eligibility_status is eligible/allowed OR checkout policy explicitly accepts recheck after a new quote
a new checkout-time stock+shipping quote succeeds for the chosen exact variant and destination
selected variant is the variant represented by the quote

observed_endpoint_disagreement.conclusion: Do not use product-detail embedded inventory as final CJ stock truth.

hard_rules: Never refresh a timestamp without a successful external evidence call.
Never count Price+Stock+Shipping alone as Fresh Shelf without a current controlled product scan marker.
Never mix price, stock or shipping evidence from a different variant than the controlled scan variant.
Never mark checkout-ready from shelf freshness alone.
Never change market_eligibility_status from this refresh lane.
Never overwrite retail price from a supplier cost field.
Never promote a stale catalog stock count over a fresh variant quote.
Never write a positive stock/shipping observation when the corresponding CJ verification flag is false.
A single product lookup failure is recheck evidence, not permanent-removal proof.
Unreconciled observations from another source do not override a newer controlled scan.
evidence_write_scope: Existing hunt_product_observations only, through controlled refresh worker; evaluator itself is read-only.

cj_fresh_department_contribution.note: Conservative CJ-only contribution to the 17 canonical departments; not total multi-supplier shelf readiness.

remaining_truth_rule: 57 CJ products are Fresh Shelf Verified for IL. The remaining 19 CJ items stay blocked/recheck. Printful/Gooten public catalog liveness does not count as Fresh Shelf without destination shipping truth.

provider_rules.CJdropshipping: Controlled scan VERIFIED + exact-variant retail/profit + stock + IL shipping evidence.
provider_rules.Printful: Public product/variant stock is useful partial truth, but Fresh Shelf remains blocked until destination shipping + fulfillment credentials and HUNT retail price truth exist.
provider_rules.Gooten: Public catalog availability/price is partial truth only; Fresh Shelf remains blocked until API credentials prove variants + destination shipping + fulfillment.

price_gate_v2.bug: Old margin floor ignored payment/refund reserves while final margin gate subtracted them.
